design: Use the fixed five phases and seven disjoint frame pairs from the parent study.

Fit one dimensionless symmetric positive semidefinite 9×9 shape per held-out pair, tile, parity, fold and preprocessing mode from exactly six other pairs. Estimate each source-pair matrix with non-overlapping 3×3 blocks in parent interior support. Normalize separately by mean diagonal and average equally over pairs.

Use the same held-out image's measured scalar input variance in the learned-shape model and the independent-input baseline. The held-out pair contributes zero covariance-shape samples. No tuning from held-out results.

Evaluate both against the parent empirical variance of 2×2 output sums. Compare median and P95 relative errors, number within 10%, and the count of pair-level medians that improve. Do not claim independent samples across tiles, folds, parities or phases, and do not infer native behavior or detector physics.
